    Getting started

    4 units · about 25 minutes

    1. 1Make your first request to CopilotAbout five minutesUnit 1 · about five minutes · 3 steps
      1. Open VS Code and the chat
      2. Have Copilot create a practice folder
      3. Open the practice folder in VS Code
    2. 2Change Copilot's work, then undo itAbout 10 minutesUnit 2 · about 10 minutes · 3 steps
      1. Have Copilot write meeting notes and an action list
      2. Ask Copilot to turn the action list into a table
      3. Undo the table
    3. 3Have Copilot explain code you didn't writeAbout five minutesUnit 3 · about five minutes · 3 steps
      1. Have Copilot build a small tip calculator
      2. Ask Copilot what the tip calculator does
      3. Ask Copilot which lines work out the tip
    4. 4Give Copilot custom instructions for a folderAbout five minutesUnit 4 · about five minutes · 4 steps
      1. Ask Copilot to summarize the meeting notes
      2. Have Copilot save custom instructions for summaries
      3. Ask for the summary again, and compare
      4. Have Copilot delete the custom instructions

    Change many files at once

    On this page
    • 1. Have Copilot create practice notices
    • 2. Ask what would change, and change nothing yet
    • 3. Make the change on copies

    You end with: updated copies of a folder of files, with the originals unchanged.

    You need: the copilot-practice folder open in VS Code. If another folder is open, on the File menu, select Open Recent, and then select copilot-practice.

    When: the same change is needed in many files, such as a new phone number, a renamed team or a replaced term.

    1. Have Copilot create practice notices

    Five of the notices give the same phone number, so you know how many files should change.

    1. If the control at the bottom of the chat box doesn't show Agent, select the control, and then select Agent.
    2. In the chat box, enter:
    In the copilot-practice folder, create a folder named notices. In it, write eight short, made-up notices to staff about office services. In five of them, give the service desk's phone number as 555-0100. Add or change no other file.

    Check: notices holds eight files. If it holds a different number, expect that number below.

    2. Ask what would change, and change nothing yet

    Seeing which files a change touches lets you catch a wrong match before anything changes.

    1. Enter:
    In the notices folder of the copilot-practice folder, list each file that gives the phone number 555-0100, with the sentence it's in. Don't change any file yet.

    Check: the reply lists five files. If it lists a different number of files, expect that number below.

    3. Make the change on copies

    Working on copies leaves the originals as they were.

    1. Enter:
    In the copilot-practice folder, create a folder named notices-updated. Copy every file from the notices folder into it. In the copies, replace 555-0100 with 555-0199, and change nothing else in them. Tell me how many files you copied and how many you changed. Add or change no other file.
    1. If a permission request appears, allow it if it copies files from notices and changes only files in notices-updated.

    Check: Copilot reports eight files copied and five changed, and notices-updated holds eight files. Open one of the five in notices-updated. It gives 555-0199. Open the same file in notices. It still gives 555-0100.

    To use your own folder: open the folder that holds it. Send the same requests, except the one that creates practice files. Use your folder's name in place of notices and your change in place of the phone numbers, and leave out the practice folder names.

    If it does not work: Help.
